entities.title: lodestar-core and the layered source
entities.summary: The game's source, layered: the lodestar-core crate (use cases, features, capabilities) and, around it, infrastructure, presentation and hosting.
entities.purpose: src/lib.rs is the lodestar-core crate: the deterministic rules with no engine dependency, in three layers that point inward (use_cases → features → capabilities). The other folders are the outer layers: infrastructure/ (lodestar-infrastructure), presentation/ (the lodestar-bridge crate and the Godot scenes), hosting/ (lodestar-godot, the GDExtension library).
boundaries: Nothing in lodestar-core depends on Godot; the crate graph keeps it out, and tests/layers.rs keeps the inner layers pointing inward.
The sim uses f64 with + − × ÷ and sqrt, plus only the functions RULES names, and draws random numbers only from its own seeded generators.
